name: Office-Home
description: Domain-adaptation classification benchmark with 4 domains and 65 classes, containing about 15.5k images. Office-31 (Amazon, Webcam, DSLR, 31 classes) is a related benchmark using the same protocol. Open research terms; no data vendored.
citation: Venkateswara, H., Eusebio, J., Chakrabar, S., & Jagadeesh, V. (2017). Deep Hashing Network for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation. Office-Home dataset. IEEE Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR).

license.identifier: Open research terms (no SPDX identifier stated)
